title: Keep commons at theme index 0 in plan/_themes.yaml

facts.note: The theme map file path is directly observable; the invariant applies to the file whenever it exists or is expected, regardless of who edits it.
Any creation, write, removal of the theme map file, or a validation run over the existing repository map (including maps that are already invalid). No diff on index 0 is required to fire.

fires: plan/_themes.yaml is created for a repository.
A theme is added, renamed or removed at a non-zero index of plan/_themes.yaml (the whole map must still satisfy the invariant).
The index-0 entry is renamed, replaced or deleted.
The theme map is rewritten or reordered.
plan/_themes.yaml is deleted as a whole file.
Package-supplied entries are added to or removed from the map.
The planner static validator checks an existing repository's theme map, even if nobody changed it in the current task.
doesNotFire: Edits to wagons, WMBTs, acceptances or other plan files that only reference existing themes, when no validation of the theme map is being performed.

given: A repository's theme map plan/_themes.yaml (the resolved theme set) is authoritative and repository-owned; its only package-supplied entry is commons at index 0.
when: plan/_themes.yaml is created, edited, reordered, deleted or validated, by any actor, whether or not index 0 is touched.
then: plan/_themes.yaml MUST declare commons at theme index 0.
prefer: Add repository-specific themes at any other (non-zero) index, as long as each is a valid theme.
Ensure the end state has index 0 exactly 'commons' — keep it there, or repair the map so it becomes commons if it is currently missing or wrong.
avoid: Replacing commons at index 0 with a repository-specific theme.
Removing the commons floor, leaving index 0 empty, or deleting the theme map file.
Moving commons to a different index or shifting another theme into digit 0.
Adding other package-supplied entries to the map beyond the required index-0 commons.
why: Commons at digit 0 is the mandatory, non-removable floor of every theme set; the rest of the map is owned by the repository and may be extended freely.
evidence: plan/_themes.yaml exists, parses and its index-0 entry is 'commons'.
The planner static validator (planner.static.validators.bun) reports no finding for this rule.
verifier_detail: Term resolved_theme_set = the theme map declared in plan/_themes.yaml; values: floor = commons at digit 0, removable = false.
Fail if the file is missing, or index 0 is missing, empty, or any value other than 'commons'; other indexes may hold any valid theme. Evaluate the end-state map, not the diff.
The repository-owned map is authoritative; the only package-supplied entry is index-0 commons.
